answer: An archive market holds voyage journals, terrace surveys and relic scans. Each paid storage replica uses a distinct encoding bound to its provider key. Unpredictable block challenges have deadlines shorter than rebuilding a replica; proofs must establish continued possession of that encoding. Divide a fixed budget by verified stored bytes, with no signup reward. A farmer needs extra disk space and audit bandwidth for extra shares, even across many aliases. This assumes replicas cannot be cheaply compressed or regenerated, and checks run throughout the rental period.
